title: 下一步前停一停
description: 成人在低墙稳稳停住，看一眼下一脚点，厚垫区清空。

art_direction.medium: crisp digital comic ink and quiet halftone shadows
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult pauses between moves on a low vertical wall, both feet secure on broad footholds and both hands relaxed around oversized jugs. The head turns slightly toward a nearby next foot placement while the hips remain calm. A second adult waits beyond the landing boundary rather than beneath the climber. Show the quiet moment of regaining balance, an obvious downclimb path, and plenty of uninterrupted mat under the wall. Use a soft graphite-and-watercolor illustration with precise posture contours, luminous color washes, and cool blue balanced by warm ochre. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
